Synopsis:
    The Guardian editorial argues that European heatwaves — responsible for nearly 35,000+ deaths across Europe in summer 2024 — are systematically underframed as disasters relative to their actual lethality. It calls for structural changes in public communication, government reporting, and community responsibility mechanisms (naming heatwaves, faster death toll reporting, expanded early warnings) to shift public perception and drive climate adaptation urgency.
